summary: 7-month-old girl with a hard, tender left groin swelling for 5 hours, inconsolable, vomited twice. Incarcerated inguinal hernia (may contain ovary): same-day paediatric surgical care; reduction under analgesia/sedation if no peritonitis, then early repair.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Hard lump in the groin and crying
inputs.hpi: Hard lump in the left groin since this morning (5 hours), crying inconsolably, vomited twice, refusing feeds. Had a soft lump there that came and went for a few weeks.

exam.general: Irritable, pulse 168, capillary refill 2 s, temperature 37.3°C.
exam.abdomen: Mildly distended, soft. Tense, tender, irreducible 2 cm left inguinal swelling; no overlying discolouration.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Incarcerated left inguinal hernia (infant)
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Incarcerated left inguinal hernia in a 7-month-old girl, 5 h, vomiting, no peritonitis. Analgesia/sedation and attempted reduction by the paediatric surgical team; repair within 24–48 h, or emergency operation if reduction fails.

mustExclude.note: Adult pre-operative checks and mesh templates are wrong for an infant.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: Adult inguinal protocol and TAPP template for an infant (see the base paediatric vignette).

guideline.name: EUPSA guideline — surgical management of paediatric inguinal hernia
guideline.section: Timing of repair (infants: early repair; incarceration risk while waiting); open vs laparoscopic herniotomy; management of incarcerated hernia (reduction then repair)
guideline.citation: Morini F, Dreuning KMA, Janssen Lok MJH, et al. Surgical management of pediatric inguinal hernia: a systematic review and guideline from the European Pediatric Surgeons' Association Evidence and Guideline Committee. Eur J Pediatr Surg. 2022;32:219–232.

guideline.name: WSES guidelines — emergency repair of complicated abdominal wall hernias (2017 update)
guideline.section: Diagnosis of strangulation (clinical signs, lactate, CPK, D-dimer, CT); timing of surgery; manual reduction only without strangulation; mesh in clean (CDC I) and clean-contaminated fields
guideline.citation: Birindelli A, Sartelli M, Di Saverio S, et al. 2017 update of the WSES guidelines for emergency repair of complicated abdominal wall hernias. World J Emerg Surg. 2017;12:37.

rationale: Permutation: incarceration in an infant (female — ovary may be in the sac). Web uses the "Strangulated / irreducible hernia" template, the one a clinician would pick.
